Galron press review — the open rows

Generated from galron_press_match_review.tsv as it stands today, so every row below still exists in the current matcher output. Decided rows are omitted.

57 open
250 decided
6 contested papers
Confirm 108
Reject 128
Research Further 12
Not A Newspaper 2
What a decision means. CONFIRM — this Zylbercweig org is the paper Galron lists. REJECT — different publications. RESEARCH_FURTHER — the title matches but something (usually the years) needs a source first. NOT_A_NEWSPAPER — the Zylbercweig side is not a serial at all. Nothing of Galron's is minted: his list is a reference, not a source of organizations.
